offer.text: A coven's been cooking trouble in the swamp — bad potions, worse luck. There's coin in it if you put down three of the witches.

accept.text: Mind their throwing arm. Those bottles bite.

in_progress.text: How many witches off the board?

ready.text: Three covens' worth of mischief, ended. Here's your coin.

complete.text: Clean work. I'll know who to call next time there's a contract.
